2609.38538.title: ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations
2609.38538.paper_summary: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.
2609.38538.paper_summary_zh: 隨機拆分在資料集包含相關樣本時可能會產生非獨立的訓練-測試子集，這在某些應用中（如生化研究）是常見的。這導致過於樂觀的泛化估計。在此，我們介紹ReLaG，一個模態無關的框架，通過階層潛變量過程建模樣本相關性，並使用鄰近圖和社群檢測推斷相關樣本的群組，以產生獨立的訓練-測試子集。在分子和蛋白質資料集上，ReLaG的表現與現有的關係感知方法相匹配，同時在擴展性上有顯著改善，使得在之前不切實際的資料集大小上進行拆分成為可能。我們進一步介紹了一種無標籤的程序，該程序將拆分解析度調整為生產數據，將評估與預期的部署設置對齊。ReLaG推斷的群組提供了有效資料集大小的廉價估計，實現了多樣性感知的資料集擴展。ReLaG是開源的，可以通過pip install relag安裝。
